description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Ithcaske Yerdaxans)
- Vendor B (Belcasyer Risan)
- Vendor C (Oztirith Ithbrelu)
- Vendor D (Drarinans Sovok)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Ithcaske Yerdaxans):
  - Vendor A offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor A completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor A reported 9 major outages last year
Vendor B (Belcasyer Risan):
  - Vendor B keeps backups only on-site
  - Vendor B has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor B provides on-site staff training
  - Vendor B has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor B currently serves 2 hospital clients
Vendor C (Oztirith Ithbrelu):
  - Vendor C meets accessibility standards
  - Vendor C guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor C had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C has no published product roadmap
Vendor D (Drarinans Sovok):
  - Vendor D has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor D has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor D quoted a total cost of 355 thousand per year
  - Vendor D currently serves 4 hospital clients
